run.requirements: Production-ready canonical Pons and Project V2 wallet launch with post-graduation custody safety

summary.building: An atomic Pons and Project V2 launch that remains governance-safe after Uniswap v4 graduation
summary.topRisk: The historical release omitted the current Pons locker and singleton PoolManager from one-time voting exclusions
summary.mustDecideFirst: Confirm the final Production multisig and hardened-release deployment sequence
summary.watchOutFor: The required SDK 2.1.0 packages are unpublished and the public RPC is not recommended for Production

risks.title: Required 2.1.0 package is not published
risks.detail: The registry exposes 2.0.0 as latest and no 2.1.0 version, so clean remote builds cannot resolve the UI dependency.

risks.title: Simulation can be mistaken for launch proof
risks.detail: Simulation does not persist state or prove wallet UX; exact payload verification and a wallet-signed canary remain required.

risks.title: Production defaults to a rate-limited public RPC
risks.detail: Robinhood explicitly says the public endpoint is rate-limited and not recommended for Production.

risks.title: Graduation custody was omitted by the historical Project release
risks.detail: Tokens held by the current locker and singleton PoolManager can inflate eligible voting supply and holder eligibility unless both are finalized as exclusions.

risks.title: Future major hook changes require vote-accounting review
risks.detail: The current _update override is correct for 5.6.1, but major library upgrades must revalidate that transfer customization point.

risks.title: Production wallet connections require external domain configuration
risks.detail: A missing or unverified Production origin causes documented AppKit failures even when application code is correct.

risks.title: Preview parity can hide missing Production configuration
risks.detail: Preview and Production have independent variables and domains, so Preview success does not prove Production readiness.

preCodingDecisions.title: Immutable graduation custody set
preCodingDecisions.detail: Finalize exclusions for the predicted adapter and curve plus live locker 0x1006fA85294A9c38AA4214d52c86CC970Ddc5647 and PoolManager 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951.

preCodingDecisions.title: Production release authority
preCodingDecisions.detail: Confirm the final multisig before ownership transfer or one-time integration binding.

preCodingDecisions.title: Production RPC provider
preCodingDecisions.detail: Choose a provider-backed endpoint and quota/abuse policy for browser reads and launch simulation.

requirementsCorrections.detail: GovTest proves single-token identity but not post-graduation custody safety.
The current Pons locker and v4 PoolManager must be included before one-time voting exclusion finalization.
SDK, ABI, and deployment packages 2.1.0 must be published together for a clean Vercel build.
Production RPC provider, Reown domains, and final ownership remain external configuration decisions.

openQuestions: Unresolvable from public sources: the final Production multisig has not been confirmed.
Unresolvable from public sources: current Reown project-domain dashboard state is private.
Unresolvable from public sources: npm publication authentication is operator state.
